fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch id of the reporting branch

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: SUB_COUNTY ID
fields.description: SUB County code of the county where the reporting branch is located he indicative buying rate for each particular currency

fields.name: DENOMINATION
fields.description: Notes and coins per the denominations of Kenyan currency.

fields.name: DATE CONFISCATED
fields.description: Date when the counterfeits were confiscated. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: SERIAL NUMBER
fields.description: The unique serial number identified on the counterfeit note

fields.name: DEPOSITORS NAMES
fields.description: The names of the person making the deposit

fields.name: TELLERSNAMES
fields.description: The name of the teller receiving the counterfeit note

fields.name: DATE SUBMITTED TO CBK
fields.description: The date when the note was submitted to CBK. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}
